description: A stream read inside a transaction lists the changes committed before the transaction began and none of the transaction's own: those reach the stream with the COMMIT, and a ROLLBACK leaves the stream as it was. Pinned for an APPEND_ONLY stream, for one read after a flush (only the new rows), for rollback, for a standard stream where an UPDATE nets to a DELETE plus INSERT pair, and for a stream over a UNION ALL VIEW where each branch's rows route correctly. The cross-schema cases: a stream living in a different schema from its table captures the table's committed changes, and only that table's, so two schemas holding a same-named table do not cross-capture.

steps.sql: CREATE STREAM s ON TABLE t APPEND_ONLY=TRUE
CREATE STREAM s ON TABLE t APPEND_ONLY=TRUE
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE reset AS SELECT * FROM s
CREATE STREAM s ON TABLE t APPEND_ONLY=TRUE
CREATE TABLE t (id INT, v VARCHAR)
CREATE STREAM s ON TABLE t
UPDATE t SET v = 'z' WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE active (id INT, st VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE del (id INT, st VARCHAR)
CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT id, st FROM active UNION ALL SELECT id, 'DELETE' AS st FROM del
CREATE STREAM vs ON VIEW v APPEND_ONLY=TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vs WHERE st = 'DELETE'
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS src_schema

CREATE OR REPLACE STREAM s_cross ON TABLE src_schema.raw APPEND_ONLY=TRUE SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS=FALSE
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS schema_a
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS schema_b
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE schema_a.t (id INTEGER)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE schema_b.t (id INTEGER)
CREATE OR REPLACE STREAM s_a ON TABLE schema_a.t APPEND_ONLY=TRUE SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS=FALSE

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE other_schema.active (id INT, st VARCHAR)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE other_schema.del (id INT, st VARCHAR)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v AS SELECT id, st FROM other_schema.active UNION ALL SELECT id, 'DELETE' AS st FROM other_schema.del
CREATE OR REPLACE STREAM vs ON VIEW v APPEND_ONLY=TRUE
